''See also: [[Northstrider Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Northstrider, also known as Master Northstrider, is a legendary [[Monarch]] who walks the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]]. A powerful and imposing figure, he is described as a tall, muscular man with golden, slit-like eyes, wild hair, and black [[scales]] covering his hands up to his elbows. He is known as a [[dragon]]-eating [[Monarch]] who consumes [[sacred beasts]] in the world's deepest regions to acquire their power. As a wandering artist without a formal sect or clan, he serves as a leader for unaffiliated [[sacred artists]] and maintains a presence in the territory between the [[dragons]] and the [[Akura clan]]. Northstrider is the creator of [[Ghostwater]], a [[pocket world]] he constructed to research ways to enhance his mental processes and sharpen his mind. His abilities include the use of [[hunger madra]], the capacity to copy the wills of those he devours into his techniques, and the ability to command fundamental principles through his Authority{{!}}authority. He has demonstrated immense power, including the ability to manipulate space and Way{{!}}the Way, though he has also been known to operate beyond his current power levels. Throughout his history, he has been a significant enemy of the Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons and has engaged in conflicts involving high-level entities like [[Reigan Shen]]. Despite his reputation as a mythic figure, he has faced significant challenges, including sustaining a major injury from the [[Weeping Dragon]] and being reported dead by some for several years.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Northstrider is a huge, muscular man with glowing golden eyes that feature vertical slits like those of a gold [[dragon]]. His hands are covered in black [[scales]] up to his elbows, and he has been described as having red-scaled fists.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A powerful [[Monarch]] and [[Sage]], Northstrider is a master who possesses the [[willpower]] of his rank and an intense curiosity that resonates with [[hunger madra]]. He is a [[dragon]]-eater who has made many [[dragons]] part of himself, and he once attempted to build a collective mind to enhance his mental processes.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Following the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]], Northstrider utilizes [[blood]], [[hunger]], force, and Wind aura{{!}}wind aura to perform various techniques. He can manifest a [[Remnant]] made of [[blood madra]] with red curling horns, use [[Enforcer]] punches, and employ a [[Consume]] [[technique]] that can copy the wills of those he devours. Additionally, he possesses [[spiritual perception]], an [[oracle codex]] for predictions, and the ability to restore both minds and bodies.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Northstrider is a [[Monarch]] on the [[Path of the Hungry Deep]] who created [[Ghostwater]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2">''Ghostwater'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19">''Ghostwater'', chapter 19</ref> Nearly fifty years before his death, he abandoned [[Ghostwater]] and withdrew both his presence and protection from the realm.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c2" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c7">''Ghostwater'', chapter 7</ref> In an attempt to enhance his mind, he built a [[pocket world]] and even attempted to create a collective mind, though this endeavor failed due to a lack of initiative and creativity.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15">''Ghostwater'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18">''Ghostwater'', chapter 18</ref> Scholars have theorized that a super-[[spirit]] of [[Dreamseeds]] was intended to manage thoughts for him.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c13">''Ghostwater'', chapter 13</ref> He maintained personal quarters within the facility and scattered over four thousand memory storage [[constructs]] throughout the world.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16">''Ghostwater'', chapter 16</ref> Northstrider left [[soulfire]] stored at the base of the basin and established that returning the [[Eye of the Deep]] to the tree would grant a single question and one drop of Ghostwater{{!}}ghostwater.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c18" /> He possesses [[Eyes of the Deep]] as well as a smooth black orb [[construct]] that serves as an advanced version of them.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c19" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Northstrider is a great [[Monarch]] and wandering traveler of the [[Trackless Sea]] who died in combat against the [[Weeping Dragon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10">''Uncrowned'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21">''Uncrowned'', chapter 21</ref> Emerging from a ragged, blue-edged hole in midair, he possesses golden eyes with vertical slits and black [[scales]] that cover his hands up to his elbows.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref> As one of the youngest Archlord{{!}}Archlords ever, he serves as the patron of the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned tournament and oversees the competition from a [[Monarch viewing platform]] atop a ball of dark, floating [[water]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21" /> He commands the start of the matches and decides the matchups for the contestants, including pitting [[Yerin]] against [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c17">''Uncrowned'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c18">''Uncrowned'', chapter 18</ref> While his protection remains in effect during the [[tournament]] rounds, he uses his power to carry competitors through the air and eventually announces the Akura prime team{{!}}Akura team as the victors.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Champion and Battle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Having previously brought back the dead, Northstrider is a champion whose emblem features a red [[dragon]] head with golden eyes.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14">''Bloodline'', chapter 14</ref> He is capable of utilizing both force and Blood aura{{!}}blood aura, even using his power to draw streams of [[blood]] into vials through mere thought.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17">''Bloodline'', chapter 17</ref> Possessing a [[void key]] and an unparalleled understanding of the nature of [[hunger madra]], he can also push through Way{{!}}the Way to travel.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /> During combat, he slammed his fist into the [[Dreadgod]]'s head and employed a serpentine [[dragon]] made of scarlet [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c17" /> While moving toward the [[Wandering Titan]] in a vision, he worked to recover his [[spirit]] midair while assessing the strength lost during his battle with The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Tidewalker Herald}} ===

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Labyrinth and Cloud Fortress}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Northstrider left an echo of himself within labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth and possesses a [[cloud fortress]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> Utilizing [[spiritual perception]] and an [[oracle codex]] for predictions, this [[Monarch]] was expected to attend the meeting with Luminous Queen Sha Miara{{!}}Sha Miara.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> While [[Lindon]] once witnessed an image of him battling the [[Wandering Titan]], Northstrider was also noted as someone who did not deign to help.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6">''Dreadgod'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7">''Dreadgod'', chapter 7</ref> Having discovered the completed [[Grand Oath Array]] at least two hundred years ago, he maintains resources to reverse-engineer Books and holds high-value projects within his personal [[void space]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c7" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c10">''Dreadgod'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" /> During a battle, he crashed from high above while trailing a red [[dragon]] of [[blood]] and [[hunger madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> He demonstrated the ability to pull [[constructs]] from a [[void space]] and focused his attention on [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> With black-scaled hands shining with [[blood]] and [[hunger]], he delivered a punch layered with an [[Enforcer technique]] that matched a blow from [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sacred Valley}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|After establishing barriers around the [[Sacred Valley]], Northstrider forged a serpentine [[dragon]] using his [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9" /> While trading techniques with [[Lindon]], he was content to keep the man locked in place.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c10">''Waybound'', chapter 10</ref> Northstrider, who possesses a [[Dreadgod weapon]] and a limb from the [[Slumbering Wraith]], fought off three other [[Heralds]] along with an echo of himself.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11">''Waybound'', chapter 11</ref> Following the dispatch of [[Striker techniques]] toward [[Lindon]], Northstrider was blasted into the earth by a Black dragons{{!}}black dragon.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c11" /> His [[Consume]] was utilized to assist in the creation of [[Yerin]]'s hunger techniques{{!}}hunger technique.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c12">''Waybound'', chapter 12</ref> As Northstrider's power thrashed inside [[Lindon]], the man was able to push that energy through a bond to [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17">''Waybound'', chapter 17</ref> Ultimately, [[Lindon]] delivered a blow to the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s head that was worthy of Northstrider.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19">''Waybound'', chapter 19</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Northstrider]]'s power was thrashing inside [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] can push [[Northstrider]]’s power through a bond to [[Orthos]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Lindon]] delivered a blow worthy of [[Northstrider]] onto the [[Weeping Dragon]]'s head.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c19" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Sunken Tower}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Northstrider maintains his seat of power within a [[fortress]] located at the [[Sunken Tower]], where his Authority{{!}}authority remains absolute.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> Residing in a simple gray room on the thirtieth floor, he was previously tutored by [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /> He has demonstrated immense capability by using [[spiritual perception]] to envelop the world for hundreds of miles and by locking the entrance to Emriss Silentborn{{!}}Emriss's prison.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref> Driven by a [[Monarch]]-level [[willpower]], he intends to gather enough power to force the [[Abidan]] to remove the [[Dreadgods]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> Despite his strength and experience manipulating Way{{!}}the Way, he is afraid to ascend and lacks an established clan or sect.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> During his interactions with [[Lindon]], who forced him to advance, Northstrider attempted to destroy an echo of his past self and used a [[Consume]] [[technique]] that caused white and gray to flood into him.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">20</span></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Ascension to Threshold}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Since ascending, Northstrider has evolved his perception beyond that of a [[Monarch]] and possesses [[spiritual perception]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref> He utilizes a Wind aura{{!}}wind aura and maintains an [[oracle codex]] alongside connections to multiple [[Icons]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /> While the stability of [[Sanctum]] has reduced the collateral damage caused by his techniques, he also possesses a gift for working with time.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /> Northstrider has made many [[dragons]] part of himself, and his curiosity resonates with [[hunger madra]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /> Although his body was once broken and twisted, it is now perfect and unassailable.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> Additionally, his Authority{{!}}authority has the capacity to heal [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]]'s techniques were reduced in collateral damage by the stability of [[Sanctum]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has an [[oracle codex]] and a connection to multiple [[Icons]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has evolved his perception from that of a [[Monarch]] since ascending.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has a gift for working with time.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Northstrider]] has made many [[dragons]] part of himself.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Return the Eye of the Deep to the tree,” Northstrider instructed, golden eyes turning to the massive scripted device. “You may ask one question and receive one drop of ghostwater.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Northstrider,” Suriel said. “Path of the Hungry Deep.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“You thinking Northstrider can split us up again after?”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“Has the time come for the champion to name her wish?” Northstrider asked.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c14" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“I need your word that you won’t attack me while my guard is down,” Northstrider said.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" />}}
